limitations: Purposive cases reviewed by an automated assistant; not independent multi-reviewer ground truth.
Case agreement measures declared expectations only; global extraction precision is not estimated.
Pinned source hashes in evaluation receipts identify the exact version tested; publisher revisions may require re-review.
Cases check expected statements and explicitly forbidden statuses within declared product selectors. Unlabelled output and version branches are not exhaustively evaluated.
